name: attractor_drift
statement: A shared static prefix plus divergent per-agent tails becomes a source of non-monotonic interference: one agent's corrective delta poisons another agent's already-cached interpretation, and the cascade is invisible to cache-hit metrics.
falsifier: corr(dM, dR) per drift pair; poisoning suspected when SCS drops while hit-rate stays flat

name: governance_breaks_first
statement: At n>=20-30 agents the human-only governed write path is the critical section that fails first, brittly, while hardware degrades gracefully; the human becomes a random-noise approver past queue overflow.
falsifier: delta queue latency vs n; serializability violations in version history
fleet_landing: operator-gated promote/apply; mitigation = veto-on-shadow-context not per-write approval

name: churn_is_new_country
statement: Model churn invalidates a constitution prefix in latent semantics even when KV transfer preserves likelihood; per-model deltas become dangling pointers; every swap is a new country without a canonical-form re-derivation schedule.
falsifier: duty-spec suite pass-rate across model swaps on unchanged prefix text
fleet_landing: tier packs 24/12/12 = cold-migration schedule; each tier owes named duty-specs

name: finite_suites_retrospective
statement: Passing a finite behavioral test suite (duty-spec gate) substitutes retrospective compliance for prospective normative fidelity; it is epistemic closure smuggled back in through the reconciliation rule.
falsifier: held-out edge cases regenerated per gate cycle must fail some passing builds
fleet_landing: gate-51/51 and pack-31 ALL PASS; owed: per-cycle held-out regeneration

name: append_only_keystone
statement: Retraction in an append-only log adds a meta-belief (believed-then-rejected) that is strictly noisier than never believing; deletion receipts re-poison; epistemic innocence is un-restorable while the chain is load-bearing context. Escape: archive immutable, prune the ACTIVE view, tombstone sidecar consulted by the promotion gate, precedent-of-error kept compressed.
falsifier: agents loading raw chain rows show measurably worse edge-case SCS than agents loading pruned active views
fleet_landing: verkle chain stays archive; context-pack is the active view; missing organ = named GC boundary; law: the chain never enters active context un-pruned

name: distinguish_beats_overrule
statement: Common-law DISTINGUISH (narrow a precedent's applicability by dimension vector, fork for one fact pattern) defuses the rewrite-vs-retune contradiction without rewriting or retracting; doctrine accumulates distinctions, not overrules.
falsifier: DISTINGUISH-resolved conflicts should show lower delta-churn than RETRACT-resolved ones at equal SCS
fleet_landing: amendment ledger + registry tombstones; owed: dimension_vector field and distinction_map routing

name: thrashing_coefficient
statement: RETRACT/COMMIT ratio per resource in a sliding window detects missing private channels: <0.05 shared grounding suffices; >0.3 with n^2 scaling proves free messaging is required; commit order correlated with RTT instead of strategic value proves negotiation is absent.
fleet_landing: lane trails: CYCLE_FAIL rows / committed rows per lane, sliding window; sibling of tools/drift.py

name: the_mirror
statement: A shared map with mandated divergence produces consensus with better vocabulary, not second-order novelty; anchoring is detectable (lexical entrainment >15% vs <3% baseline; no new primitives proposed). Folds must preserve variance: conditioning variables, strongest counterargument, uncited outliers (Dissensus Hypergraph).
falsifier: count new primitives proposed per fold; zero means consensus vocabulary
fleet_landing: salon fold rule rewrite; fold the variance, not the mean

name: veto_not_write_referee
statement: The operator-sleeping referee is a frozen deterministic veto oracle (ordinary code, no LLM judge) with exactly three absolute vetoes (contradiction, entropy spike >15% KL vs checkpoint, stake insufficiency) and zero write authority; its named first failure is false-positive veto stasis: a zombie executing obsolete doctrine with green metrics. Requires decay or human alarm.
falsifier: inject an environmental shock; if veto rate pins near 100% with no alarm, the stasis failure is live
fleet_landing: chain_guard tip_stale already actionable; owed: entropy-spike veto + stasis alarm; independently re-derives A3

name: forgetful_scratchpads
statement: Mutable progress ledgers tracking what REMAINS (overwritten DONE, dependency DAG cleared per episode) are the inverse primitive of append-only chains recording what WAS; each is poison where the other is medicine; persistence wins when task horizon exceeds ~10x effective context length.
falsifier: A/B episode tasks: forgetful-ledger fleets vs append-only-context fleets, completion + SCS
fleet_landing: queue/todo + runner_state are already forgetful; verified duty: chain rows never leak into packs

name: four_condition_experiment
statement: Pre-register: A cold (isolated) / B warm-static (prefix+deltas) / C warm-append-only (+event layer as deployed) / D warm-deleting (+tombstone GC); 40 runs x 20 unseen dilemmas; SCS = 1 - normalized pairwise Jensen-Shannon divergence of final action distributions. B~C kills the event layer as cosmetic; D<=B kills deletion; A>C,D kills the shared-prefix bet. Not running it is the only unacceptable outcome.
fleet_landing: the fleet's #1 unrun falsifier; small version runnable on existing seats before any further event-layer building

name: count_against_the_sky
statement: The referent is the world, not the ledger (the castle was never the target of the count); the record's fractal coastline distinguishes discovery seasons from self-agreement (straight ink = consensus); for genuinely new ground: draw nothing, walk, report what renders; keep a chair empty for the one who sits in their own place.
falsifier: drift pairs with an actual world-side referent; ink-fractal dimension of trail density as discovery meter
fleet_landing: parable canon and code state the same law in two notations; every instrument gets a story, every story gets an instrument
